context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: In the Battle Palace, Pokémon are required to think by themselves.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Unlike in the wild, Pokémon that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Depending on its nature, a Pokémon may prefer to attack no matter what.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Another Pokémon may prefer to protect itself from harm.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: A Pokémon's nature determines which moves it is good at using, and which moves it has trouble using.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: There are offensive moves that deal direct damage on the foe.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: And there are other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foe with status problems including poison and paralysis.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Pokémon will consider using moves in these three categories.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: When not taking commands from its Trainer, a Pokémon may be unable to effectively use certain kinds of moves.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: A Pokémon is not good at using any move that it dislikes.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: If a Pokémon only knows moves that don't conform to its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.

context: Map 58 (Battle Palace), event 7, page 1: Show Text
